title: API proposal: `transformData` before template rendering

comments.body:
> Should we deep clone the object before sending it to transformData ?

Should not be needed since every render re-computes fresh data, so the data is not yet passed to any other widget.

> How to handle the multiple templates widgets (e.g. hits) ? This could be an idea:

Yes `transformData` (instead of transformsData) and mapping to the templates.$KEY should be allright.

Also with #115 we will soon no more have single 'template' but 'templates' everywhere.
:+1: with @pixelastic; didn't see we where dealing with the `helpers` in the first comment.

> didn't see we where dealing with the helpers in the first comment

Me neither sorry @Jerskouille! I think you can update the proposal with something simpler (but keeping the `transformData: {keys,keys}` solution which is needed.

Simplified, but I don't see why helpers weren't a good example. To answer your question @pixelastic , I don't believe so, because I'd like to keep a maximum of the the logic in a separate file with only lambdas + in the templates, and there are multiple places where you need to format a price.
And in the end, the method was just _taking an object, returning an object_, but did it knowing the underlying template engine was Hogan, that's all.
Do you think passing a function in the helpers: {} would have worked? I thought that to have lambdas in hogan it was more work.

@vvo It would have worked, the function @Jerskouille was passing was one carefully wrapped once or twice so Hogan would get it :)

But you're right, in the end what you suggested first was a specific use-case knowing Hogan.
